months.note: 6월 중순~9월 초에 기록되었고 죽거나 지친 채 발견된 개체가 많으며, 국내에서 기록된 달이다.

summary: 한반도에서는 해마다 10건 미만으로 기록되는 길잃은새다. 해안이나 바다의 섬에서 살며, 모래 위 오목한 자리에 적갈색 얼룩이 있는 흰 알을 1개 낳는다. 우리나라를 비롯해 말레이시아, 타이완, 일본 등지에 분포한다.
young: 어린새는 온몸이 검은 갈색이고 등과 날개덮깃의 깃 끝에 흰 점이 줄지어 있으며, 가슴까지 어둡고 배 아래쪽만 희끄무레하다.

similar.how: 검은등제비갈매기는 조금 더 크고 윗면이 더 검고 고르며, 이마의 흰 무늬가 눈 뒤로 이어지지 않는다.

art.subject: Sooty Tern (Onychoprion fuscatus), adult, as seen on Korean offshore islands: black crown and nape continuous with the blackish-brown back, upperwings and tail; broad white forehead patch reaching back only to the eye; black line from the bill to the eye; cheeks, throat and underparts white; outer tail streamers edged white; bill long, slender and black; dark eye; legs short and black.
art.scene: Korean coast in spring or autumn: the sandy shore of an offshore island; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on sand: broad white forehead ending at the eye, black cap joined directly to the blackish back with no pale collar, white underparts, slender black bill, short black legs, deeply forked tail
adult, in flight seen from above, head, body and tail in line: uniformly blackish upperwings and back, white forehead, deeply forked tail with long white-edged outer streamers
art.build: Large, slim tern, about 40cm including the tail streamers, larger than Common Tern, with long, narrow, sharply pointed wings and a deeply forked tail with long outer streamers. Bill black, slender, about as long as the head. Legs short and black. In flight the upperparts look uniformly blackish, the underwing white with contrasting dark flight feathers, and the long streamers show white outer edges.
avoid: Do not paint a pale collar between cap and back, a grey-brown back, or a white eyebrow extending behind the eye; those are Bridled Tern (Onychoprion anaethetus).
Do not paint a pale grey back like most terns; the upperparts are blackish.
Do not paint a red or yellow bill.
Do not give it a crest.
